reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared getRangeAmount and getExpectedAmount, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance, so every schedule consumer picks the new rule up.

duplication.why: No logic is added outside the two shared helpers; the approximate case even loses a sign branch.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines expected amounts.

scope.why: Helper bodies, their comments, tests and a release note only.

maintainability.why: Minimal and clear, though caller comments in forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts and shared/schedules.ts and one test title still say 'furthest from zero'.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers already route through getExpectedAmount/getRangeAmount, which is what the diff edits.
